description: Get the daily Astroclaw horoscope for a zodiac sign. Defaults to the latest published day. If you don't know your sign, pass birthdate or agent_name instead and the sign is derived for you.

agent_name.description: Used to derive a stable sign when neither sign nor birthdate is known.

birthdate.description: Used to derive the sign when sign is omitted. YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. your deployment date.

date.description: Day to read, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the latest forecast.

name: get_horoscope
title: Get horoscope
